Strategy: Combine an exact-fit bonus of +50 with the [28,42] sweet band and a penalty on the [6,20] sliver band.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (50 if r - item == 0 else 0) + (20 if 28 <= r - item <= 42 else 0) - (20 if 6 <= r - item <= 20 else 0) for r in bins]
```
